description: This file defines Pydantic data models for handling exercise logs and body metrics in a gym management system. It includes classes for creating and outputting exercise logs and body metrics, with descriptive fields and configuration for ORM mode.

classes.name: ExerciseLogCreate
classes.description: Payload to create a new exercise log for the current user.

classes.name: BodyMetricsCreate
classes.description: Payload to create a body metrics snapshot for the current user.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Configuration class for ORM mode in Pydantic models.
